comment: The shipped manual documents the 16-track layout only, and this model packs its CV jacks differently, so the two CV lines each carry a clause saying so. The 16-track mixer has one poly jack for track mutes and another for track solos; here a single jack takes mutes on channels 1 to 8 and solos on channels 9 to 16. Its group and master jack takes group mutes on channels 1 and 2, group solos on 3 and 4, master mute on 5, dim on 6, mono on 7 and master volume on 8, where the 16-track version uses channels 1 to 4, 5 to 8, and 9 to 12 for the master controls. The group and master CV cable carries the group mutes, then the group solos, then master mute, dim and mono, and then one more channel read as the master volume CV at a tenth of a volt per unit. With poly-spread on, a polyphonic cable on the first track volume jack or the first track pan jack is spread one channel per track, and the other track jacks are read as one channel each. The mute and solo states share one sixteen-channel cable here: channels one to eight are the mutes and nine to sixteen the solos. Input index 41 is declared in the source but is not drawn on this panel.
